category_edits.rationale: Blend the existing readout with a 10% contribution from a masked, causal mean of GRU states with a 10-step half-life. This may recover persistent interests while retaining the incumbent readout's dominant signal. Applies to all four datasets; the generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training/inference consistency.

def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Prefix normalization yields weight 2**(-age/5) at every valid step.
        positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=out.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        weights = torch.exp2((positions - (seq.size(1) - 1)) / 5.0)
        weights = weights.unsqueeze(0) * seq.ne(0).float()
        numerator = torch.cumsum(out.float() * weights.unsqueeze(-1), dim=1)
        denominator = torch.cumsum(weights, dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = numerator / denominator.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny)
        return pooled.to(out.dtype)
edits.replace:
def aggregate_states(self, out: torch.Tensor, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=out.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        offsets = positions - (seq.size(1) - 1)
        mask = seq.ne(0).float()
        states = out.float()
        tiny = torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny

        weights = torch.exp2(offsets / 5.0).unsqueeze(0) * mask
        numerator = torch.cumsum(states * weights.unsqueeze(-1), dim=1)
        denominator = torch.cumsum(weights, dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        current_readout = numerator / denominator.clamp_min(tiny)

        # Prefix normalization gives 2**(-lag/10), with lag zero
        # at the latest valid position in each causal prefix.
        slow_weights = torch.exp2(offsets / 10.0).unsqueeze(0) * mask
        slow_numerator = torch.cumsum(states * slow_weights.unsqueeze(-1), dim=1)
        slow_denominator = torch.cumsum(slow_weights, dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        slow_mean = slow_numerator / slow_denominator.clamp_min(tiny)
        return (0.9 * current_readout + 0.1 * slow_mean).to(out.dtype)
